capabilities: Import Instagram video URLs from a queue note into Markdown notes
Extract captions and source metadata with yt-dlp
Transcribe audio locally with faster-whisper (English-only or multilingual)
Canonicalize URL variants and deduplicate sources by shortcode
Run dependency and network checks from the plugin settings
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory, so installation is manual (ZIP plus a Python wheel). Desktop-only because it spawns local processes. Tested end-to-end only on Ubuntu; Windows and macOS are untested. Photo-only /p/ posts are rejected.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Instagram video posts into notes with caption, metadata, and a transcript.

relations.evidence: Extracts caption and source metadata with yt-dlp.
Creates temporary 16 kHz mono audio for local transcription with faster-whisper.

summary: Imports Instagram video URLs as structured Markdown notes with captions, metadata, and optional local Whisper transcription via a Python CLI.
